acquisition.bodyInterpretation: Three exact registered archived originals plus one separate BLCU award context reused with original observation timestamps and hashes. Seven new bounded URL reads saved five HTML bodies and two historical BISU PDFs. Relevant PDF date pages visually inspected offline. Landing/index/app shell is never exact deadline proof.

rules: Source-only date observations; no canonical dates, status, publication or whole-record freshness changed.
Archived source reuse retains the actual old observedAt and original hashes and counts as zero new website reads. Only the newly dispatched IDs are assessed.
BFSU two ICLT degree rows exactly match storedMay30 dates; the degree award ownMay30 is a separate past candidate. Previous012 language and held correction scopes are neither replayed nor imported.
Applicant-labelled degree deadlines remain separate from university/CLEC review/result stages and from self-funded or unrelated scholarship routes.
BIPT2026 title and signed guide anchor its shared degree application column; language and interview periods are separate. Named independent awards lack their own dates.
One broad provincial award ID is counted once at assignedBFSU; BLCU own-award dates do not prove itsBFSU scope.
BISU2023/2024 periods and BLCU historical or2026 listings do not become2026/2027 successor windows.
Unknown never establishes open/closed status, programme cessation or whole-school catalogue completeness. One linked fallback per landing then cooldown.

precisionIssues.explanation: Previous012 language-route December30/October31 issue is outside these IDs. The BFSU host table is not treated as a universal CLEC schedule.
Annual degree timing cell spans bachelor and master. Explicit2026 title/signature bind the observed year; language seasonal cells and interview months are excluded.
Historical documents do not establish the current award cutoff; record remainsunknown.
